verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents connecting both Gmail and Outlook accounts and switching between them inside one app. It also documents adding all Gmail and Outlook account calendars to one consolidated view. Nothing in the evidence shows IMAP or other non-Gmail/Outlook providers, and switching between accounts is not shown to be a unified inbox. missing for 10: IMAP/generic provider support, evidence of a unified multi-account inbox, independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-account use.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can connect several accounts across providers — Gmail, Microsoft 365, IMAP — and work them from one place

citations.quote: you can instantly switch between Outlook and Gmail accounts without switching apps.
You can add all your Gmail and Outlook account calendars, and easily toggle them on and off. One single, consolidated view when you need it
Connect all your Gmail and Outlook accounts, including work, personal, and side projects.
